text: Guzarish ye hai ke Surjani Town Sector 7-A ki galiyon mein unannounced load shedding 14 ghante tak pohnch gayi hai emergency halat hain. Daily commuters aur shopkeepers is soorat-e-haal se be-inteha pareshan hain aur traffic muattal hai. Higher authorities se appeal hai ke aam shehriyon ki pareshani par tawajjah dein aur fori relief faraham karein.

Mohtaram afsaran, hum Khokhrapar sector 2 ke tax-paying shehri hain aur nihayat dukh ke sath ye report likhwa rahe hain. Haqeeqat ye hai ke solid waste walon ki la-parwahi se bimariyan phailne ka shadeed andesha hai. Is waja se local businesses aur schools dono mutasir hain aur bimar afraad hospital nahi ja sakte. Staff ke sust rawayye ki waja se mohallay mein ehtijaj ki faza ban rahi hai jo kisi bhi waqt mazeed barh sakti hai. Baraye meharbani is critical grievance ko top priority par hal kiya jae aur field team rawana ki jae.

Assalam o alaikum, hum Old Golimar main chowk ke rehaishi hain aur pichle kafi arsay se shadeed pareshani mein mubtila hain. Hamari gali mein Shadeed gham-o-gussa phail raha hai! neutral wire break hone se high voltage aya hai aur ghar ke AC aur TV phat gaye. Foran theek karo warna ehtijaj hoga. Is maslay ki waja se bache aur buzurg sab shadeed museebat mein hain aur aam guzar-gah band ho chuki hai. Humne pehle bhi multiple times complaint cell par rabta kiya magar koi sunwayi nahi hui sirf aana kani se kaam lia ja raha hai. Aap se darkhwast hai ke fori notice le kar team ko field mein depute karein taake mazeed nuqsan na ho.

Attn Municipal Commissioner: In Malir Cantt check post 5, Had ho chuki hai is bay-hisi ki! commercial area mein waste management walon ne safai karna band kar di hai. Foran theek karo warna ehtijaj hoga.

Janab aala, hum pichle bees saal se Ancholi society Block 20 ke mustaqil rehaishi hain aur nihayat dukh aur sadme ke sath ye arzi guzar rahe hain. Hamare ghar mein mere buzurg walid hain jinki tabiyat shadeed kharab rehti hai aur unko 24 ghante medical oxygen machine ki ashad zarurat parti hai. Sath hi mere teen chote bache hain jinke board ke annual imtihanaat sar par hain aur unki parhai shadeed mutasir ho rahi hai. Afsos is baat ka hai ke pipeline crack hone ki wajah se gas ka bara leekage hai dhmaka hone ka andeesha hai! in jahilon ko koi aqal nahi hai. Awam ko pagal banaya hua hai. Humne pichle das roz mein baraha helpline 118 aur local complaint cell par formal shikayat darj karwai hai aur complaint number 84920 bhi mila. Lekin har dafa duty officer sirf jhooti tasalli deta hai ke emergency response van rawana ho chuki hai jo aaj tak nahi pohanchi. Pura mohalla shadeed azab mein mubtila hai aur tamam rehaishi shiddat se mutaliba karte hain ke aala afsaran is sangheen soorat-e-haal ka fori notice lein. Agar aglay 24 ghanton mein staff ne physical visit na kiya to hum tamam rehaishi sarak par aakar

Mohtaram afsaran, nihayat dukh aur afsos ke sath ye shikayat darj karwa raha hoon ke hamare ilaqa Gulshan-e-Hadeed phase 1 commercial mein civic facilities ka bohot bura haal hai. Hum tax ada karne wale shehri hain magar badlay mein humein ye khwari milti hai. Asal sangheen masla ye hai ke gali ke konay par kachray ka pahar ban chuka hai char din se koi dumper nahi aya! haramkhor administration bilkul andhi ho chuki hai. Awam ko pagal banaya hua hai. Is kharab soorat-e-haal ki wajah se gali ke tamam dukaandar aur rehaishi shadeed nuqsan utha rahe hain aur karobar bilkul thapp ho chuka hai. Humne 20 afrad ke dastakhat ke sath formal application bhi submit karwai thi magar registry clerk ne sirf stamp laga kar file dabba di. Awam ka sabar ab jawab de chuka hai aur agar aglay 24 ghanton mein team na ayi to hum ehtijaj karenge. Khuda ke waste is museebat se hamari jaan churayein.

Janab-e-wala, arzi guzaar hain ke Soldier Bazaar near garden mein pichle do hafton se aisi ghair mamooli halat paida ho gayi hai jis ne sab ka jeena haram kar diya hai. Asal kharabi ye hai ke chikna kaam karne ke bajae so rahe hain! Citizens are enduring extreme mental and physical agony due to administrative negligence. Basically road ki carpeting ukhar chuki hai aur pathar urr kar pedistrians ko lagte hain. Immediate response expected. Har roz subah log daftar aur bache taleemi idaron ke liye nikalte hain to raste mein zillat uthate hain. Humne local elected councilor aur assistant commissioner office ke chakar kaatay magar wahan sirf thande kamron mein baten banti hain zameen par koi nahi ata. Hum kisi siyasi jalsay ke khwahish mand nahi hain sirf apne bunyadi shehri haqooq ka mutaliba kar rahe hain. Umeed hai aala hukkam is notice ka jaiza le kar fori tor par action orders jari karenge.
